effects: Deploys a new EigenPod (beacon proxy) at a CREATE2 address salted with the signer's address and initializes it with the signer as pod owner (EigenPodManager._deployPod: pod.initialize(msg.sender); ownerToPod[msg.sender] = pod).
Reverts if the signer already has a pod; one pod per address (createPod: require(!hasPod(msg.sender))).
Not payable; no tokens or ETH move and no approvals are set (mined case 0: effects empty, signerNet empty).
formats.shown: The screen shows only the intent "Create EigenLayerPod" with no fields, which matches a no-argument, non-payable call that creates the signer's own EigenPod.

findings.title: createPod intent does not say the new pod is owned by the signer.
findings.evidence: EigenPodManager.sol _deployPod: pod.initialize(msg.sender); ownerToPod[msg.sender] = pod. Descriptor intent "Create EigenLayerPod". Case 0 reader lists as unsure: "Whether I will be the pod's owner (likely, not shown)". The owner is always msg.sender, so the outcome is as implied.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as "Create your EigenPod" to make the ownership and the protocol's term (EigenPod) explicit.

cases.notes: The mined tx moved no tokens or ETH and set no approvals. Its only effect is a new EigenPod owned by the signer, which the intent states. The reader correctly inferred that a pod tied to their wallet was created.
